items.headline: Utah, BYU and a rivalry game that delivered in every way
items.description: Despite a 10 a.m. local time kickoff, Utah fans brought the energy -- and some colorful language -- from early in the morning in their big-time win over BYU.

items.headline: Devon Dampier puts Utes 'on his back' for blockbuster win over BYU
items.description: In what was the first-ever Holy War matchup between BYU and Utah as top-10 teams, the game delivered a blockbuster that featured several big momentum swings and a QB in Devon Dampier at the center of it all who propelled the Utes to a 28-20 win.
